fact: The Ministry of Health's Direction des systèmes d'information is running a second training session for administrators of OpenClinic, an open-source integrated hospital management system that includes clinical and nursing records, chosen at a workshop with the directors general of the CHU and CHR; the platform is deployed at two pilot sites, the CHUR of Ouahigouya and the CHR of Manga.
title: Digitalisation de la gestion des hôpitaux au Burkina : Des administrateurs en formation dans la région du Nazinon
